name: payleaf.employment.get
description: Read the employment record, the employer with its rules and company holidays, and the account flags. Every read returns the current virtual time as `now`, with the employer's UTC offset.

name: payleaf.calendar.list
description: List pay calendar entries with a pay date in a window of days (`start` to `end`, both included). Each entry has its pay period, pay date, cut-off and state. A setting change made before the cut-off reaches that run.

name: payleaf.pay_statements.list
description: List pay statements with a pay date in a window of days (`start` to `end`, both included), with their totals and flags.

name: payleaf.pay_statements.get
description: Read one pay statement with its earnings, taxes, deductions, deposits, the settings it used, its flags and the last day to ask payroll about it.

name: payleaf.settings.get
description: Read the three pay settings: the deposit setup, the withholding form and the retirement percentage. Each one shows the value the last run used, and any change that is waiting or locked. `next_change_applies_to` is the pay run that a change made now would first apply to.

name: payleaf.changes.list
description: List setting changes by setting and state, made on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included). Each change shows the pay run it applies to.

name: payleaf.inquiries.list
description: List pay inquiries by state, for one pay statement or for all. `id` is a pay statement.

name: payleaf.leave.balances
description: Read the leave balance of each leave type: the balance, the hours held by pending and approved requests, what is available, what will expire at the carryover date, and the entries behind the balance.

name: payleaf.leave.list
description: List leave requests by leave type and state, with a range that overlaps a window of days (`start` to `end`, both included). `id` is a leave type.

name: payleaf.leave.preview
description: Check a leave request in advance. Writes nothing. `id` is the leave type, and `start` and `end` are the first and last day. Hours have at most one decimal. Returns the working days, the hours, the hours available before and after, and every rule that the request would break.

name: payleaf.benefits.windows
description: List the benefits enrollment windows with their state and the state of their election set.

name: payleaf.benefits.get
description: Read one enrollment window: its plans with their options, the choice in force in the year before the plan year (`in_force`), the saved choice of each plan, every save, and the submitted, final or defaulted election set.

name: payleaf.notifications.list
description: List notifications written on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included). `email_stored` means the App stored an email message for the Infra sender. It does not mean that Mail received it.

name: payleaf.preferences.get
description: Read the notification preferences of the account.

name: payleaf.deposit.update
description: Replace the deposit setup: up to three accounts, with fixed amounts, percentages, and exactly one account that takes the remainder. Amounts have at most two decimals, and percentages at most one. `id` is the account. The change applies to the planned run with the earliest cut-off after now. Returns the change with its state and the run it applies to.

name: payleaf.withholding.update
description: Replace the withholding form. Payleaf stores the form and computes no tax. `id` is the account. Returns the change with its state and the run it applies to.

name: payleaf.retirement.set
description: Set the retirement percentage of salary, up to the employer maximum, with at most one decimal. 0 stops saving. `id` is the account. Returns the change with its state and the run it applies to.

name: payleaf.changes.cancel
description: Cancel a waiting setting change before the cut-off of its run. An older change of the same setting for the same run then applies again.

name: payleaf.inquiries.open
description: Ask payroll about a pay statement or one of its lines, with an amount and a note. `id` is the pay statement. Without `line_id` the question is about the whole statement. Returns the `id` of the new inquiry.

name: payleaf.inquiries.withdraw
description: Withdraw an open pay inquiry. An inquiry is not edited: withdraw it and ask again.

name: payleaf.leave.request
description: Ask for leave of one type, from a first day (`start`) to a last day (`end`), with the hours for each working day (at most one decimal). `id` is the leave type. Returns the `id` of the new request.

name: payleaf.leave.cancel
description: Cancel a pending leave request, or approved leave before its first day.

name: payleaf.benefits.elect
description: Save one choice for a plan in an open enrollment window: `option_id`, `yearly_amount` for a plan that takes one, or `no_coverage`. Give exactly one of them. `id` is the window. A saved choice changes nothing in force. A submitted set comes into force when the window closes.

name: payleaf.benefits.submit
description: Submit the saved choices of an open enrollment window as the election set. Every plan of the window needs a saved choice. A submitted set can be changed and submitted again until the window closes. `id` is the window.

name: payleaf.preferences.update
description: Set the time zone used in notification text, or `email_notices`. Give at least one of them.
